parsed.evidence_sentence: Code E2101 is also covered for those with impairment of manual dexterity when the basic coverage criteria (1)-(2) are met and the treating practitioner certifies that the beneficiary has an impairment of manual dexterity severe enough to require the use of this special monitoring system. Coverage of code E2101 for beneficiaries with manual dexterity impairments is not dependent upon a visual impairment.
parsed.wording_differences:
Original: "Code E2101 is also covered for those with impairment of manual dexterity when the basic coverage criteria (1)-(2) are met and the treating practitioner certifies that the beneficiary has an impairment of manual dexterity severe enough to require the use of this special monitoring system."
Revised: "Code E2101 is also covered for those with impairment of manual dexterity when the basic coverage criteria (1)-(2) are met and the treating practitioner certifies that the beneficiary has an impairment of manual dexterity severe enough to require the use of this special monitoring system. Coverage of code E2101 for beneficiaries with manual dexterity impairments is not dependent upon a visual impairment."

Difference: The revised sentence adds: "Coverage of code E2101 for beneficiaries with manual dexterity impairments is not dependent upon a visual impairment." Otherwise, the wording is identical.
parsed.explanation: The only difference is the addition of a clarifying sentence stating that coverage for E2101 due to manual dexterity impairment does not depend on visual impairment. This does not narrow or widen the scope of the original requirement; it simply clarifies it. The operative criteria and thresholds remain unchanged.
